answer: Agents register in lagoon, whose consensus contract accepts only zero-knowledge proofs of TPM/SGX remote attestation, binding each enclave key to measured code and a hardware nonce. jade is the append-only identity state tree; orchard is its hash anchor and slashing verifier. Forging N identities requires provisioning distinct compliant silicon continuously and defeating attestation; bonds follow an O(N^2) quadratic curve, with failed proofs irreversibly slashed.
